paragraph.es: Instructor senior en cursos intensivos de **Talento Digital — SENCE**, iniciativa del Gobierno de Chile: desarrollo full stack en Java, Python y JavaScript, e Ingeniería de Datos con Machine Learning sobre AWS. También instructor senior de Java en **Alura Latam**, como Oracle Developer Professional.
paragraph.en: Senior instructor in intensive **Talento Digital — SENCE** courses, an initiative of the Government of Chile: full stack development in Java, Python and JavaScript, and Data Engineering with Machine Learning on AWS. Also senior Java instructor at **Alura Latam**, as an Oracle Developer Professional.
